aogPerils.mitigation: Cyclone-rated towers (IEC Class I), nacelle yaw-to-wind strategy, blade feathering
aogPerils.details: Wind turbines in Gujarat/AP/Odisha coast face cyclone gusts >200 km/h; tower collapse risk

aogPerils.mitigation: LPS receptor system on blades, down-conductor to earthing, SPD on all circuits
aogPerils.details: Blade tip receptors most vulnerable; lightning causes blade delamination and control system damage

aogPerils.mitigation: Seismic-rated foundation design, structural health monitoring sensors
aogPerils.details: Foundation cracking, tower tilt, nacelle misalignment in seismic zones (Gujarat, NE India)

nonAogPerils.mitigation: CMS blade monitoring, regular visual/drone inspection, leading edge protection
nonAogPerils.details: Leading edge erosion, root crack, lightning damage causing blade throw or structural failure

nonAogPerils.mitigation: Oil analysis (quarterly), vibration monitoring, CMS alarm thresholds
nonAogPerils.details: Bearing failures, gear tooth damage; 6-12 month lead time for replacement; crane costs ₹50L/day

nonAogPerils.mitigation: Winding temperature monitoring, partial discharge testing, insulation resistance checks
nonAogPerils.details: Winding insulation failure, bearing damage in DFIG generators

nonAogPerils.mitigation: Structural health monitoring, bolt torque checks, foundation inspection
nonAogPerils.details: Fatigue cracks at welded joints; critical risk in repowered sites with upgraded turbines on existing foundations

nonAogPerils.mitigation: DGA analysis, thermal imaging, backup transformer strategy
nonAogPerils.details: Wind farm pooling transformers handle variable load cycles; insulation aging accelerated

emergingRisks.description: Salt spray, marine growth, and splash zone corrosion on monopile/jacket foundations
emergingRisks.insurance: Marine cover with corrosion warranty extension

emergingRisks.description: Rain, sand, and insect erosion on blade leading edge reducing aerodynamic efficiency by 5-25%
emergingRisks.insurance: Extended warranty cover, LEP (Leading Edge Protection) maintenance contracts

emergingRisks.description: New larger rotors on existing towers/foundations may exceed design load envelope
emergingRisks.insurance: Structural assessment condition precedent; enhanced MLOP cover

emergingRisks.description: Over-reliance on digital twin predictions leading to missed maintenance; cyber vulnerability
emergingRisks.insurance: Cyber cover extension, professional indemnity for service providers

bestPractices.benefit: Early detection of drivetrain faults; 3-6 month warning before catastrophic failure
Modern LPS receptors reduce blade lightning damage by 80%
Detect leading edge erosion, cracks, delamination before structural failure
Tower and foundation strain gauges detect fatigue progression; critical for repowered sites

caseStudies.title: Cyclone Tauktae — Gujarat Wind Farms
caseStudies.description: Category 4 cyclone with gusts >185 km/h damaged 50+ turbines in Kutch region. Tower collapses, blade throws, nacelle fires. Largest single wind claim in India.
caseStudies.learning: Cyclone-rated Class IA turbines essential for Gujarat coast; yaw-to-wind strategy must be tested annually

caseStudies.title: Gearbox Serial Defect — Tamil Nadu
caseStudies.description: Design defect in planetary stage affected 120 turbines from single OEM. Required full gearbox replacement; crane mobilization took 4 months.
caseStudies.learning: Diversified OEM portfolio; CMS mandatory for early detection; crane contracts pre-arranged

caseStudies.title: Tamil Nadu Lightning — 200 MW Farm
caseStudies.description: Monsoon lightning strikes damaged blade tips on 35 turbines. Control systems and SCADA also affected.
caseStudies.learning: Annual LPS inspection; blade receptor continuity testing; comprehensive SPD installation

caseStudies.title: Blade Throw Incident — Rajasthan
caseStudies.description: Blade root bolt failure caused blade throw; secondary damage to adjacent turbine and access road.
caseStudies.learning: Bolt torque verification during annual maintenance; ultrasonic bolt testing for aging turbines

caseStudies.title: Foundation Crack — Repowered Site, Maharashtra
caseStudies.description: Foundation designed for 600 kW turbine showed cracks after 2.1 MW repowered turbine installed. Tower tilt detected by SHM.
caseStudies.learning: Mandatory structural assessment for repowering; foundation load envelope verification before re-commissioning
